scope: engineering equivalence of categorical observations with declared rectangular geometry

geometry.site_order: explicit row-major entity ID list for each relational representation
geometry.state: native u32 symbol or relational entity type
geometry.edge_schema: type 0, unordered arity 2, both roles 0, one relation per undirected edge

fixture.variation: different IDs, entity order, edge order, and endpoint order in the relational traces

decision.projection: identical row-major symbols at each frame and identical common CLTR bytes under shared output metadata
decision.scores: identical exact categorical baseline and frozen two-entry temporal scoring, with both motifs used
negative_controls: different relation type or port role

limits: known coordinates, fixed geometry and existing CLTR channels; no graph layout inference or engine comparison
